question: Which independently originated public intervention evidence can responsibly support LCRM causal transfer, and what additional authenticated source, intervention-design, temporal, resource and control evidence remains missing?
audit_hypotheses: FORGE sourcebirth signatures certify structural source identity only. They neither independently attest an intervention assignment nor grant first-use; code currently recognizes Wingless and Yggdrasil birth lanes, not LCRM.

Published CausalBench single-cell Perturb-seq includes original gene perturbation labels for some experimental samples and independent public upstream provenance, but no authenticated paired eight-event role/state episodes or unit-level do-counterfactual ground truth.

An externally fixed GitHub repository/commit or published source description alone does not authenticate the exact download bytes, randomized/exogenous assignment design, or new/unused source-family status.

predecessor.FSA_governance: Existing CKB-plane sole scientific admission and first-use authority. Source-only verification cannot authorize execution.

exact_required_fields_for_new_causal_mem: external data provider identity, provider-side content hash, license and raw data acquisition custodian
source-born exact raw payload hash and independent retained signature/seal, time ordering and source novelty check
public pre-intervention exogenous or source-state match, node/entity identity, assignment target/value and assignment-design evidence
sequential observed post-assignment transitions and per-entity event ordering, not one cross-sectional cell profile
explicit no-leakage FIT/CHECK/heldout boundaries and equivalent public labels for candidate, fully trained sequence-aware peers and symbolic controls
authenticated distinct-family original holdout with separate first-use, zero hard FP, causal ablations, baseline and whole-OS CPU/RSS nonregression

admissibility.public_gene_network_side_track: Potential separately preregistered source-neutral perturbation generalization, but cannot be mislabeled multi-step relational-memory success

forbidden: No original/new synthetic case birth, protected first-use, source download and consumption, recombination of old scientific cases, model changes, parameter increases, paid API, new controller, workstation, main merge or release promotion.
next_conditional: Verify original raw dataset producer records and independently pinned bytes plus causal assignment validity; if temporal counterfactual composition is absent, obtain a distinct independently born sequential intervention source before FSA admission.
